decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from honojs/hono PR #5096, merged 2026-07-12. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. replaceUrlParam in src/client/utils.ts built a per-parameter regex with no end boundary -- new RegExp('/:' + k + '(?:{[^/]+})?\??') -- so when one parameter name is a prefix of another (id vs idType) the shorter pattern matched inside the longer token: replaceUrlParam('/a/:idType/:id', {id:'1', idType:'slug'}) produced '/a/1Type/:id'. The fix appends a (?=/|$) lookahead. NOTE the bug only manifests when the longer parameter appears EARLIER in the URL than the shorter one -- '/posts/:id/:idType' happens to substitute correctly at the base commit because the shorter pattern's first match is the intended token -- so the tests deliberately place the longer parameter first. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (67efb27f); the slice keeps src/, package.json and tsconfig.json and drops .github, benchmarks, perf-measures, docs, runtime-tests and every in-tree *.test.ts. Hono is dependency-free at runtime, so the node-ts image runs the hidden tests with tsx and no install step. Coverage: 4 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to produce a corrupted URL at the base commit and the correct one after the gold patch, covering a plain prefix collision, one with a regexp constraint, one with an optional marker, and the reverse naming direction (userId before user). The 4 pass_to_pass guards use only parameter names where none is a prefix of another -- a single param, multiple distinct params, a regexp-constrained param and an optional param -- so they pass at the base commit.

fail_to_pass.name: prefix_not_matched_inside_longer
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb prefix param is not matched inside a longer param$' vb_url_param_prefix.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: prefix_with_regexp_constraint
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb prefix param with a regexp constraint is not matched$' vb_url_param_prefix.test.ts
